description:
Turn music into moving visuals with PulseCanvas Studio for Apple Vision Pro.

Explore hundreds of Metal-powered visualizers, with more added all the time. Start with the included soundtrack or import your own audio, choose a favorite effect, and shape its colors, motion and beat response.

YOUR MUSIC, YOUR SHOW
Build a Studio timeline with scenes aligned to the song’s beat grid. Give each scene its own bar length, choose visualizers from favorites or categories, and randomize the entire timeline for a fresh sequence. A slider grid puts Chaos, motion, zoom, brightness, size, depth and blur within reach.

LISTEN WITH RADIO
Choose a station and let PulseCanvas Radio pair music with moving visuals. Save songs with a heart, browse and manage Favorite songs, or play a station that shuffles only your saved music. Shuffle the visuals or favorite an effect as you listen. Radio stations and songs load from the online library; your imported soundtracks and Studio projects stay on your device.

STEP INTO FULL IMMERSION
Watch on a curved virtual screen. Keep your room visible or hide it for full immersion. Floating playback controls stay out of the way while you watch.

CREATE AND KEEP
Save Studio projects, reopen them later, and exchange native-visualizer projects with the Mac app. Export an MP4 with your soundtrack included, in wide, phone or square formats, at resolutions up to 4K and frame rates up to 60 fps.

COMPLETELY FREE
No subscriptions, in-app purchases or paid features. No account, advertising or tracking. Source code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/protomota/pulsecanvas

Requires Apple Vision Pro running visionOS 2 or later. Radio requires an internet connection. Project files save settings and soundtrack references; imported audio is not embedded. Locate the soundtrack when moving a project between devices. Export time varies with the effect, resolution and device. Use music and other material you have permission to use.
promotionalText: Music you can step into. Explore hundreds of visuals, create beat-aligned Studio timelines, listen with Radio, and watch in full immersion. Completely free.
reviewNotes:
Native visionOS app using Apple Metal. No projectM/OpenGL engine, external preset pack, Sparkle updater or account system is included. Source: https://github.com/protomota/pulsecanvas . All app features, including commercial video creation with the official app, are free. First-party source has separate noncommercial source-available terms; this is not a claim that every asset is MIT or public domain.

Studio and Radio are in the pinned top-left switch. Studio starts with the bundled soundtrack paused; Play starts playback. The left library selects visualizers and its filter limits selections/randomization by category or favorites. Selecting a nonfavorite visualizer creates a fresh randomized look; a saved favorite restores its appearance settings. Reset restores defaults.

The Studio timeline has beat-aligned scenes with per-scene bar lengths. Tap a card header to choose its effect. Randomize timeline can change effects and/or bars; Apply to all adjusts common controls. Save project and Open project exchange .pulsecanvas files with the Mac app. Audio is referenced separately; locate it when moving between devices.

Radio has its own workspace and transport. Its visualizer name, heart, randomizer and group filter sit above the preview. Song title/heart, station picker, Next song and Favorite songs sit below; playback and volume are on the last row. Play Radio loads public station JSON/audio from https://radio.pulsecanvas.si/stations.json and starts playback without sign-in. The song heart saves music; Favorite songs opens the saved-song list and its Play favorite songs action starts a favorites-only queue. The station menu also includes Favorite songs. With no saved songs, instructions appear rather than unrelated playback.

The goggles icon in the bottom ornament opens immersive viewing. Hide room chooses full or mixed immersion. Pinch/tap the visual to reveal floating controls, or Back to Studio to leave. Controls auto-hide during playback. Hi-hat strobe is optional and off by default. Chaos at zero disables music-driven pulses/flashes while procedural motion can continue. The visuals include fast motion and simulated movement.

Import audio uses Files. Export MP4 offers wide, phone or square output, 720p/1080p/4K and up to 60fps. Render video generates the movie; Save video opens the system Files picker. Higher resolution exports can take longer. A successful Files save is confirmed in the app; canceled/failed saves do not count for rating milestones.

About & Support opens from the info button, with Rate on the App Store, Share PulseCanvas, Send Feedback and Legal & Credits. Tip the Developer appears only when StoreKit reports a USA storefront; unknown/other storefronts omit it. There is no reward, paywall or rating-score filter. After the second saved video, the app may request Apple's native StoreKit review sheet once when idle, with no custom rating pre-prompt. Apple controls presentation and suppresses it in TestFlight. Leaving a fourth Radio session is an alternative milestone for that same one-time request.

No account, advertising, tracking, user-file upload or audio recording. Imported audio/projects stay on-device. Radio requires internet for the public catalog and music downloads.
subtitle: Music visuals, made by you
